fix_specification_reasoning.intended_behavior: The function should determine if a train traveling from station X to station Y will stop at station Z. For an inbound train, this means checking if Z is between X and Y when X < Y. For an outbound train, this means checking if Z is between Y and X when X > Y. The function should print "Yes" if the train stops at station Z and "No" otherwise.
fix_specification_reasoning.diagnosis_and_repair_directions:
The flawed specification incorrectly evaluates the condition `x < z < y`, which only checks if Z is between X and Y for an inbound train. It fails to account for the outbound train scenario where X > Y. The condition should be adjusted to handle both scenarios:
1. For inbound trains (X < Y), check if X < Z < Y.
2. For outbound trains (X > Y), check if Y < Z < X.
The specification should be updated to evaluate these conditions and print "Yes" if either condition is true, otherwise print "No".
